## Name & positioning

## FAQ
Q1. What is ReturnCopy?
A1. ReturnCopy generates return/refund policy and reply drafts for e-commerce teams.
Q2. Who should use it?
A2. Merchants and CX leads writing or refreshing return policies.
Q3. Is it legal advice?
A3. No. It drafts communications; local consumer law and counsel still win.
Q4. What do I provide?
A4. Your store context, return window, and any special constraints.
Q5. Can it draft customer replies too?
A5. Yes. It can draft customer-facing return replies alongside policy text.
Q6. Does it guarantee compliance?
A6. No. Deterministic checks help catch risky phrasing; jurisdiction review stays with you.
